The Supreme Court just upheld this bedrock American principle: if you cast your ballot on time, your vote will count.

Participation in democracy should never be limited – not by your race, where you live, or how you vote.

As the midterm elections approach, Trump and his allies are working overtime to silence Americans’ votes. Senate Democrats will continue to do everything we can to protect free and fair elections, where everyone’s voice is heard.
